[size=3]🍅🌽🥬🍆[/size]

A recolour of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url]﻿ to match Cometkins' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Foraging.[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262]6480[/url]﻿ created the crops and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/102170063]xxjasmine[/url]﻿ (Jas) recoloured most of these crops in her original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14740]6480's Giant Crops for Better Crops and Foraging[/url]﻿ mod, I just made a few adjustments, turned it into a CP mod, and made it 1.6 compatible. [b]Please thank and credit 6480 and Jas for their work! ♡[/b]

[b][u][/u][/b][b][u][color=#ea9999]The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url]﻿ mod is required[/color][/u][/b] for this mod to work, so make sure you download it!
[i](and all other mods required by the original!)

[/i]In the configuration options you can choose between Vanilla or Better graphical styled melons, and choose between the colours Pink or Green. [size=3]🩷🍈💚[/size]

You can also choose between a natural coffee bean plant or a coffee cup like the one in 6480's Giant Crops mod. ☕️ It will default to the coffee cup automatically.

I [i]highly[/i] recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ to change your configuration settings in-game. Please see this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1906]Article[/url]﻿ for manual changing of the config options.
